<templatestyles src="Template:Enchant/styles.css" />

'''Runes''' are a unique class of items found all over the map that give the player a specific buff upon equipping. 
[[File:Runes.png|thumb|250px|''A Rune'']]

== Mechanics ==
[[File:Runes UI.png|thumb|280px|''Runes UI'']]
* Rune slots are found in the [[Equipment]] section of the [[Prospector Kit]].
* There are a total of 5 Rune slots. Leveling up unlocks more slots.
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;font-size:smaller;margin-left:2em;"
|-
! Level !! Slots
|-
| 1 || 1
|-
| 10 || 2
|-
| 20 || 3
|-
| 30 || 4
|-
| 40 || 5
|-
|}

 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#6A5ACD;">Abyssal</span>]]  
 || [[File:Abyssal Rune.png|50px]]
 || Gain 20% more luck during the night. Darkness increases 50% slower.

 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#FF4040;">Annihilation I</span>]]
 || [[File:inh I.PNG|50px]]
 || Automatically destroy {{common}} and {{uncommon}} ores when panning.<ref name="pin">[[Crafting_Anvil#Tracking_a_Recipe|Pinned recipe]] ingredients will not be destroyed.</ref>
 || In the tunnel from {{Deeproot Spring}} to {{Enchanted Ruins}}.
|-
 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#FF4040;">Annihilation II</span>]]
 || [[File:inh II.PNG|50px]]
 || Automatically destroy {{rare}} and {{epic}} ores when panning.<ref name="pin" />
 || Located at the far back right of {{Fungal Marsh}}, surrounded by red crystals.
|-
 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#FF4040;">Annihilation III</span>]]
 || [[File:AnnihilationIII.png|50px]]
 || Automatically destroy {{legendary}} ores when panning.<ref name="pin" />
 || Located behind a tree at {{Starfall River}}, surrounded by red crystals.
|-
 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#8CFB93;">Bunny</span>]]
 || [[File:Bunny.png|50px]]
 || Gain +5% modifier boost for every +1 bonus jump power.
 || Found on a cliff in {{Starfall River}} near the Meteor Golem NPC.
|-

 || [[File:Critical1 Rune.png|50px]]
 || Digging has a 20% chance to have 2x strength.
 || Inside the Merchant hut in {{Sunset Beach}}.
|-
 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#FFFF00;">Critical II</span>]]  
 || [[File:Critical2 Rune.png|50px]]
 || Digging has a 20% chance to have 2x strength.
 || Inside one of the huts near the Ranger on {{Caldera Island}}.

| [[Runes|<span style="color:#7CFF7C;">Eternity</span>]]

 || Inside the hut behind Old Prospector in {{Fortune River Delta}}.

 || [[File:Explorer Rune.png|50px]]

|-

 || [[File:Mountain Climber Rune.png|50px]]
 || Gain 3 walkspeed.

 || [[File:Speed1 Rune.png|50px]]
 || Gain 2 walkspeed.

 | [[Runes|<span style="color:#FFFF00;">Sunblessed</span>]]  
 || [[File:Sunblessed Rune.png|50px]]

 || Inside the area behind the waterfall/locked door in {{Crystal Caverns}}.
|-
